capabilities: Create, rename, and delete albums in a dedicated .gallery document
Import photos, GIFs, and videos with the native file picker
View media in a full-screen lightbox with keyboard and swipe navigation
Store imported media in a plugin-managed Album Gallery Assets folder
Upload selected photos with lesson metadata to an Ekatech Study account
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The Ekatech Study integration is optional, requires an account, quota depends on the Study plan, and some plans or services may be paid; only Hata Defteri photos (max 10 MB, no GIFs or videos) are uploaded, while normal albums stay local.
problem: Obsidian treats images and videos as plain vault files, with no album-style gallery view for browsing and managing a media collection.

relations.evidence: Album Gallery includes an optional Ekatech Study integration for the Hata Defteri workflow.

summary: Photo gallery manager that organizes photos, animated GIFs, and local videos into Apple Photos-inspired albums stored in a dedicated .gallery file.
